## Names

<a id="music_instruments"></a>
### [`music_instruments`](../../../src/music_data.asm#L19) `$E80A-$E849`

*data*

8 instruments of 8 bytes: AD, SR for articulation 0 (normal), AD, SR for articulation 1 (staccato), AD, SR for articulation 2 (legato), 2 unused bytes. Command $Bn selects instrument n. The title tune uses instruments 0, 3 and 5.

- **Referred to by:** [`music_note_length`](music_player.md#music_note_length) [`$E731`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L633), [`music_note_length`](music_player.md#music_note_length) [`$E740`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L641), [`music_note_length`](music_player.md#music_note_length) [`$E74F`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L649), [`music_note_length`](music_player.md#music_note_length) [`$E782`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L679), [`music_note_length`](music_player.md#music_note_length) [`$E789`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L682), [`music_note_length`](music_player.md#music_note_length) [`$E790`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L685), [`music_note_length`](music_player.md#music_note_length) [`$E795`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L688)
- **Entry of:** [`music_song_table`](../tables.md#music_song_table)

<a id="music_filter_presets"></a>
### [`music_filter_presets`](../../../src/music_data.asm#L30) `$E84A-$E869`

*data*

8 filter presets of 4 bytes: cutoff low ($D415), cutoff high ($D416), resonance in the high nibble ($D417), filter mode ($10 low pass, $20 band pass, $40 high pass) for $D418. Command $Dn.

<a id="music_song_table"></a>
### [`music_song_table`](../../../src/music_data.asm#L65) `$E8C0-$E8C7`

*data*

Song table, 8 bytes per song: stream addresses of voice 0, 1, 2 and the instrument table address (the player uses the fixed music_instruments). Song 0 is the title tune.

- **Referred to by:** [`music_set_voice_pointers`](music_player.md#music_set_voice_pointers) [`$E373`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L68), [`music_set_voice_pointers`](music_player.md#music_set_voice_pointers) [`$E37B`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L72)

<a id="music_song1_voices"></a>
### [`music_song1_voices`](../../../src/music_data.asm#L70) `$E8C8-$E8CF`

*data*

Entry of song 1 in the song table (music_set_voice_pointers reads 8 bytes per song): voice 0, 1, 2 stream pointers and the instrument table pointer. Only voice 0 ($EAB3) points to music; $EB60 and $EC14 point into the sound effect player and its tables. No code selects song 1.

- **Read by:** [`music_set_voice_pointers`](music_player.md#music_set_voice_pointers) [`$E373`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L68), [`music_set_voice_pointers`](music_player.md#music_set_voice_pointers) [`$E373`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L68) (+2), [`music_set_voice_pointers`](music_player.md#music_set_voice_pointers) [`$E37B`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L72) (+1), [`music_set_voice_pointers`](music_player.md#music_set_voice_pointers) [`$E37B`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L72) (+3)
